articles.title: ¿Eres miembro de mesa para las Elecciones Municipales y Regionales 2026? Consulta con tu DNI
articles.summary: Consulta con tu DNI si fuiste designado miembro de mesa para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026. Revisa el enlace oficial de la ONPE y conoce los detalles del proceso.
articles.body_text: El próximo 4 de octubre el Perú acudirá a las urnas para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026, un proceso en el que millones de ciudadanos renovarán a las principales autoridades de los gobiernos regionales y locales para el período 2027–2030. Durante la jornada se elegirá a gobernadores y vicegobernadores regionales, consejeros regionales, alcaldes provinciales y distritales, además de regidores en ambos niveles. La convocatoria oficial fue realizada por el Poder Ejecutivo mediante el Decreto Supremo N.º 001-2026-PCM, publicado el 7 de enero de 2026, dando inicio al cronograma electoral. Sin embargo, la elección de los gobernadores regionales podría no definirse en una sola jornada. La legislación vigente establece que, si ningún aspirante supera el 30 % de los votos válidos, deberá realizarse una segunda vuelta regional entre los dos candidatos con mayor votación. Este mecanismo busca garantizar una mayor legitimidad en la elección de las máximas autoridades regionales. Cabe precisar que esta disposición solo alcanza a los gobernadores regionales y no se aplica a los comicios para elegir alcaldes provinciales o distritales. Si deseas saber si has sido designado miembro de mesa para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 en el Perú, puedes seguir estos pasos: Los ciudadanos que deseen verificar si fueron seleccionados como miembros de mesa para las próximas elecciones deben ingresar al portal oficial de la Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales (ONPE): https://consultaelectoral.onpe.gob.pe/inicio. Al ingresar su número de DNI, el sistema informa si la persona fue designada como titular o suplente, además del local de votación y la mesa que le corresponde. La información también suele difundirse mediante la aplicación móvil y los canales oficiales de la entidad. Quienes no cuenten con acceso a internet pueden revisar los padrones publicados en sus respectivos locales de votación. Ser elegido miembro de mesa implica una responsabilidad de carácter obligatorio durante la jornada electoral. Las personas designadas deben presentarse para instalar y conducir la mesa de sufragio, salvo que cuenten con una causa de justificación aceptada por la autoridad electoral. El incumplimiento de esta obligación puede generar la imposición de una multa conforme a la normativa vigente. Por ello, la ONPE recomienda verificar oportunamente la designación y atender las indicaciones oficiales para evitar contratiempos el día de los comicios. La Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales (ONPE) ya definió el cronograma de capacitación para los ciudadanos que sean designados como miembros de mesa en las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026. La primera Jornada Nacional de Capacitación se realizará el domingo 30 de agosto, mientras que la segunda está programada para el 20 de septiembre. Estas actividades buscan que los participantes conozcan el correcto desarrollo de la jornada electoral y las funciones que deberán desempeñar. Con ello, la entidad busca garantizar un proceso de votación ordenado y transparente. Además de las jornadas nacionales, la ONPE ofrecerá capacitaciones presenciales en las Oficinas Descentralizadas de Procesos Electorales (ODPE) y en otros locales autorizados a nivel nacional. La institución también pondrá a disposición una modalidad virtual con manuales, videos y material de consulta para facilitar la preparación de los miembros de mesa. Los detalles sobre los lugares de capacitación y el acceso a la plataforma serán difundidos conforme avance el cronograma electoral. Todo este proceso servirá como preparación previa para los comicios del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Ser designado miembro de mesa constituye una obligación establecida por la legislación electoral peruana, por lo que el cargo no puede ser rechazado de manera voluntaria. No obstante, la normativa contempla determinadas causales que permiten solicitar una excusa para quedar exonerado de esta responsabilidad. Entre ellas figuran problemas de salud debidamente acreditados, embarazo con recomendación médica, discapacidad o limitaciones físicas que impidan desempeñar la función, así como encontrarse fuera del país el día de la elección. También pueden admitirse otras circunstancias excepcionales previstas en la legislación vigente. Quienes consideren que cumplen alguna de estas causales deben presentar una solicitud de excusa ante el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) dentro del plazo fijado en el cronograma electoral, adjuntando la documentación que sustente su pedido, como certificados médicos, pasajes o constancias migratorias. La exoneración solo procede si el JNE declara fundada la solicitud. En caso de no asistir como miembro de mesa sin una excusa aceptada, el ciudadano podrá ser sancionado con la multa correspondiente. Además, si tampoco acude a votar y no está legalmente exonerado del sufragio, podría recibir una segunda sanción por omisión al voto. Los ciudadanos que cumplan íntegramente la función de miembro de mesa durante las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 recibirán una compensación económica de S/ 165, de acuerdo con lo establecido por la Ley Orgánica de Elecciones. Este monto equivale al 3 % de la Unidad Impositiva Tributaria (UIT) y se entrega como reconocimiento por la labor desempeñada durante toda la jornada electoral. La medida busca incentivar el cumplimiento de esta responsabilidad cívica y garantizar el normal desarrollo de los comicios. El beneficio se otorga únicamente a quienes ejerzan efectivamente el cargo. Además del incentivo económico, los miembros de mesa que completen la capacitación organizada por la ONPE y participen durante toda la jornada tendrán derecho a un día de descanso remunerado no compensable, aplicable tanto para trabajadores del sector público como del privado. Este descanso deberá ser utilizado dentro de los 90 días posteriores a la elección, en coordinación con el empleador. En contraste, quienes no se presenten a cumplir esta función sin contar con una excusa aprobada por el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) serán sancionados con una multa de S/ 275, conforme a la normativa electoral vigente.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on, but things are improving | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Microsoft 365 and Outlook are still seeing service degradations on Tuesday, the company's status page indicates.
articles.body_text: Microsoft’s efforts to fix what is now a multi-day outage affecting customers’ access to Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services are entering day two. The company made significant progress in addressing the problem on Monday, after an issue impacting its Exchange Online service led to email delays and failures, authentication issues, and other problems for some Outlook users. But as of Tuesday, the issues still are not fully resolved. Instead, Microsoft’s latest update shared on X says its “mitigation actions are continuing to progress,” which isn’t exactly the same as saying “all is well.” Our mitigation actions are continuing to progress within the remaining affected infrastructure. Indications from telemetry remain positive, and we've confirmed service availability is improving. We're entering a period of extended monitoring to ensure a full resolution is… While Outlook received most of the attention, Microsoft’s status page for Microsoft 365 (Business or Enterprise) indicates that other services were ultimately affected as well, including SharePoint, Copilot, Teams, Purview, Defender XDR, the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, and Universal Print. The page attributed these to an issue with a “core authentication configuration used by multiple Microsoft 365 services. Overnight, the company shared on X the steps that it was taking to resolve what its investigation found was a misconfiguration issue impacting its service. Microsoft said the problem was preventing authentication components from “deploying as expected to a portion of infrastructure.” Microsoft had first reviewed the recent changes that could have led to this problem, then it tested and implemented various mitigations to try to provide relief to end users. Over time, as these mitigations rolled out, Microsoft said Outlook users should see “gradual recovery” to their mail flow. By 10 p.m. ET on Monday, the company said that, while mail flow was improving, search functionality remained degraded. Shortly after 3 a.m. ET on Tuesday, Microsoft said it was seeing improvements with the search functionality. While many users are likely seeing improvements by now, Microsoft has not yet said its service is back to normal. Its latest message on X said that “indications from telemetry remain positive” and that service availability is improving. articles.title: Waymo accelerates robotaxi expansion with launches in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Waymo will begin inviting riders on a rolling basis and slowly ramp up access in the three cities, following its usual commercial playbook.
articles.body_text: Waymo has started to offer its robotaxi service to the public in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa, extending the Alphabet-owned company’s commercial operations to 14 U.S. cities. The company said on Tuesday that it will begin inviting riders on a rolling basis and slowly ramp up access in the three cities, following its usual commercial playbook. The expansion has increased its fleet of self-driving Jaguar I-Pace hatchbacks and a new minivan called the Ojai to more than 4,000 vehicles. The launch in these three cities comes as Tesla is striving to close the gap in the robotaxi market. Tesla now charges for rides in its driverless Tesla Model Y vehicles in Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando, and Tampa. Service in some of these markets is limited, but the company continues to expand within these cities and add vehicles to its fleet. The company is also banking on its Cybercab, a custom-built two-seater with no steering wheel or pedals, to speed up its efforts. Waymo’s announcement highlights a relentless expansion push that kicked into gear 18 months ago, and helped cement its position as U.S. robotaxi market leader. Waymo operated a robotaxi service in Phoenix for years before August 2023, when it received all the permits required to operate and charge customers for driverless rides in San Francisco. As Waymo continued to expand in the Bay Area — first to surface streets throughout the entire city, then the surrounding enclaves, and eventually the freeways that connect them — the company began to move into Los Angeles in 2024. But it wasn’t until March 2025, when the company opened its robotaxis to riders in Austin through a partnership with Uber, that its growth plan really took hold. Since then, Waymo has launched commercial robotaxi services in seven more cities, including Atlanta, Dallas , Houston, Miami, Nashville, Orlando, and San Antonio. Its pace of expansion isn’t slowing. Last month, the Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved a permit that will allow Waymo to operate up to 1,000 autonomous vehicles over the next year in Clark County, home to Las Vegas. Tesla and Uber were also granted permits by the agency. Nor is the expansion limited to the United States: Waymo is also planning to launch a robotaxi service in London and Munich. Waymo follows roughly the same plan with nearly every new market, first mapping and testing its autonomous vehicle tech, then removing the human safety operator, and eventually allowing employees, the media, and other invited guests to try the robotaxi service. How soon Waymo opens up its service to paying riders often hinges on local regulations. States such as California require permits from two different agencies, covering both the deployment of driverless vehicles on public roads and the ability to charge for rides. Waymo’s launch in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa is following a similar path. Although there is one notable difference: Waymo’s next-generation robotaxi, a Zeekr-made minivan branded the Ojai, will be the only autonomous vehicle available to riders in Denver and San Diego. The Ojai (pronounced oh-hi) features Waymo’s sixth-generation self-driving system and is designed to be cheaper to build, operate, and maintain. For now, that fleet is small, at about 300, when compared to its Jaguar I-Pace numbers. But it is expected to grow quickly as Waymo chases profitability alongside growth. articles.title: If space data centers feel far-fetched, why not interstellar travel? | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The team behind Starcloud's orbital data centers has a new high-risk space project: Sending a probe to Alpha Centauri.
articles.body_text: The founders behind Starcloud , a startup with plans to operate a fleet of GPUs in orbit, have a new pitch for potential investors: a plan to send a tiny spacecraft on an 80,000-year journey to Alpha Centauri. If they do it, it will be the first human-built object explicitly aimed for another star, and the sixth to leave our solar system. Dubbed Fermi Explorer , the non-profit behind the mission emerged today to ask for partners, donations, and advice. The initial team — Starcloud founders Philip Johnston, Adi Oltean, and Ezra Feilden, along with program manager Garret Jameson — has put together a plan to use proven space technologies to send a vehicle with a 10 cm square payload, weighing 1 kilogram, into interstellar space. The founders say they are launching this mission in the spirit of human exploration; to achieve a historical first; and to test the limits of the Fermi paradox , which attempts to explain why we have yet to find other intelligent life in the universe and gives the mission its name. The mission is intended to cost about $15 million and plans to launch in 2029. The non-profit is soliciting vendors to build the vehicle, funding to pay them, and scientific and artistic payloads to send, à la the sensors and Golden Record onboard NASA’s Voyager space probe, the first human spacecraft to leave our solar system. Most plans for interstellar exploration stumble when dealing with the vast distances involved and the comparatively slow methods we have to cross them. Voyager, launched in 1977, is now about 26 billion km from Earth; Alpha Centauri, the nearest star to our solar system, is 41 trillion km away. The last time Silicon Valley took on this challenge, a non-profit called Breakthrough Starshot, founded in 2016 by Yuri Milner and backed by Mark Zuckerberg, envisioned a multibillion-dollar effort to use a novel laser-based propulsion system to reach Alpha Centauri in 20 to 30 years. The effort collapsed in 2025 , but the dream apparently remains alive. Fermi Explorer takes the opposite tack: Rather than pushing the frontier of technology, the goal is to use what we have already to do something. “I also got excited and then disappointed!” Johnston said of Starshot. “That’s the reason we are doing the mission. We are hell-bent on actually launching something in three years … The big difference with most other [interstellar] missions and the Fermi Explorer is that the others all try to do it in a human lifetime, which means billion-dollar propulsion R&D programs. We have very deliberately picked 80,000 years as the minimum viable mission.” The plan is to launch the spacecraft on a rocket rideshare, then use efficient but low-power electric propulsion to slingshot the vehicle into a series of orbits that will eventually leave it bound for Alpha Centauri. The spacecraft is intended to be active for about 12 years before entering a final coast phase toward the other solar system. “If a dinosaur bone can last 200 million years, then a metal box can easily survive the radiation environment we expect for 50,000 years,” Johnston said. “We don’t plan on powering spacecraft up at the end of the 80,000 years. We hope that a future human civilization will intercept it.” When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . This doesn’t affect our editorial independence.

articles.title: Apple shares 'shocking evidence' against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
articles.body_text: In its lawsuit against OpenAI, Apple filed what it calls “shocking evidence” to bolster its allegations that former employees stole trade secrets for OpenAI’s benefit . These new details emerged after the legal counsel for former Apple employee Chang Liu — who now works at OpenAI — handed over Liu’s old Apple work laptop for investigation earlier this month. Apple now alleges that Liu used a confidential Apple circuit schematic in his work at OpenAI, as well as a tool that shares a name with an internal Apple engineering application. The company claims that OpenAI was “well-aware” of Liu’s access to Apple data and that Liu enlisted OpenAI colleague Yu-Ting Peng to help destroy evidence in June when he learned that Apple was investigating him. “The MacBook represents the very limited information Defendants provided so far (and only after weeks of delay), and shows Apple is not conducting ‘fishing expeditions’ but that its trade secrets are being used and evidence is being destroyed,” the filing reads. While this new evidence is redacted from public view, past filings from Apple have included text messages from Liu — which he punctuated with “crying laughing” emojis — showing he was aware that he still had access to Apple files. OpenAI has previously defended Liu by saying that he only accessed Apple files after he stopped working there in order to help former colleagues who asked for his assistance. “Apple now tries to shift the blame to ‘residual access,’ but they also don’t disclose that this is a common issue with Apple which is caused by them failing to properly manage system access when people leave,” OpenAI wrote in a blog post earlier this month. But Apple claims that Liu had continued access because he “exploited a rare, previously unknown authentication bug.” TechCrunch has requested comment from OpenAI on Apple’s newest allegations. Apple is seeking a preliminary injunction — a court order that would block OpenAI from working on hardware based on Apple’s technology while the case is ongoing — as well as expedited discovery, a fast-tracked process for gathering evidence, since the company alleges that more former employees may also be implicated. According to Apple’s initial filing, more than 400 former Apple employees now work at OpenAI. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a 'Harvey for police officers' | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.
articles.body_text: David Lawrence was a Harvard Law student when an on-campus shooting involving a police officer sparked intense controversy over police conduct. Realizing that most policing errors occur when officers lack instant access to department rules, Lawrence dropped out to tackle the problem with AI. He teamed up with co-founders Amit Patankar, a Harvard MBA and former Google engineer, and Michael Gropman, a retired Boston police deputy chief, to launch Blue Voice — a Boston-based AI startup that provides real-time policy guidance to officers in the field. Three years later, Blue Voice is coming out of stealth with $6 million in funding led by SignalFire and Las Olas VC. Officers at 225 county agencies across 25 states now rely on the tool daily to ensure their actions follow department protocol — a platform Lawrence likens to Harvey, the AI tool widely used by lawyers, or OpenEvidence, which is a similar tool for doctors. “When an officer makes a decision, they do so from memory or best guess, based on thousands of pages of law, policy, municipal ordinances, and state laws that they’ve internalized and keep in their head,” Lawrence told TechCrunch. Before Blue Voice, an officer who couldn’t recall a specific protocol — like the exact seventh step required at a crime scene — had few good options: Flip through a 15,000-page manual, wake up a supervisor in the middle of the night, or search generic tools like Google or ChatGPT that lack police-specific training. The problem was that traditional methods took too much time, while consumer AI models delivered incorrect answers up to 30% of the time, Lawrence said. Blue Voice says it solves this issue because it is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can’t access on the public internet. The platform also gives officers instant access to detailed school maps on their phones during active-shooter emergencies. Today, Blue Voice answers a question every minute. Lawrence says that officers feel confident relying on the tool because it always points them directly to original regulations rather than just generating an answer on its own the way ChatGPT would. Rather than dictating actions, the tool simply provides the laws, leaving the final decision to the officers, who combine it with their own field experience. Over the last year, says Lawrence, Blue Voice grew its customer base elevenfold because police departments see concrete results, including reduced crime and fewer operational controversies. Blue Voice recently helped prevent a kidnapping after a rookie officer spotted a man pressuring a young girl to enter his vehicle, according to Lawrence. Unsure whether he had legal grounds to intervene, the officer consulted Blue Voice on his phone. The app instantly confirmed that the situation met the legal criteria for “child enticement” — an offense covering attempts to lure a minor for the purpose of committing a crime against them — giving him the immediate authority to act. In another instance, Blue Voice reminded a department chief that he couldn’t return an officer to active-duty following a shooting without first obtaining a third-party mental health evaluation. The startup, which competes with PE-backed Lexipol, also recently developed functionality to help detectives solve cold cases. At a time when police use of AI — such as Flock Safety’s license plate surveillance systems — draws growing criticism , Lawrence hopes Blue Voice proves that properly deployed AI can deliver public safety benefits without sacrificing civil rights. Lawrence, who previously worked for Connecticut governor Ned Lamont, developed a deep passion for public service and says he has no regrets about leaving law school behind. “This is the best thing I could do with my career and the most impact I could potentially make,” he said.

articles.title: Tim Cook's parting message: Apple is in the hands of a product builder | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Tim Cook’s farewell memo to Apple employees offers a glimpse at how he wants John Ternus to be seen: as a product builder with deep experience across the iPhone, Mac, AirPods, and other major hardware lines.
articles.body_text: On his last day as Apple CEO, Tim Cook offered a rousing endorsement of his successor: John Ternus , the company’s senior vice president of hardware engineering. In a memo to employees, Cook reminded staff that he’s “not leaving Apple,” just stepping away from the role of CEO, while declaring that “few people understand what it takes to build products that change the world the way John does.” Ternus’ elevation to the top job suggests that Apple’s next era will see a renewed focus on hardware and product execution. Under Ternus, Apple shipped a number of notable products, most recently, the new ultra-thin iPhone Air, the lower-cost MacBook Neo, and AirPods with hearing health features. He also led the hardware engineering team across Apple’s full device lineup. Hardware will play an important role in the AI era, not only in terms of chips, but also the devices people use to run enterprise AI. Apple this year, for instance, offered earlier releases of its new Mac models, the Mac mini and Mac Studio, compared with years past, driven by AI demand. Cook’s memo, reported by Bloomberg and others, naturally says little about Apple’s future when it comes to AI, services, regulation, China, or the other challenges that lie ahead. Instead, Cook focuses on his gratitude for the opportunity to lead Apple and exalts the company’s culture as ultimately what matters most. “We share a belief that what we build matters and that we have both the opportunity and the responsibility to leave the world better than we found it,” Cook wrote. He also referenced the famous Steve Jobs quote about leaving a “dent in the universe,” saying that Apple makes that possible because of “who we are and what we believe,” as well as “what we value and how we see the world.” Cook will remain at Apple as executive chairman and will continue to manage political relationships, including those with President Trump and the Chinese government. On X, Cook also wrote : “Sending lots of love to the Apple community on my last day as CEO. My title changes tomorrow, but the love I have for the Apple community never will. Thank you for being a constant source of inspiration. My gratitude is endless, and I’m excited for the next chapter!” Today is my last day as CEO of Apple. This is a moment I always knew would come one day, and yet it is still hard to believe it has arrived and I am writing these words. I love this company and the team behind it, and I couldn’t let this day pass without sending a note to you to tell you how grateful I am for the outpouring of affection you’ve sent my way, for the way you’ve shown up each and every day, and most of all, for the privilege of a lifetime serving as your leader. The truth is, whatever there is to say about my success, I know it is all because of you. You have brought out the best in me. In all my life, I have never seen or been with such an extraordinary team of people before, and every day I get to see more examples of that. There is something truly special about Apple. I am most proud of what an annual report could never capture. This place is proof that culture triumphs over everything. We share a belief that what we build matters and that we have both the opportunity and the responsibility to leave the world better than we found it. That purpose is part of what makes this place extraordinary. Apple helps nurture it, but I believe it lived within each of you long before you arrived here. It is what brought you to this company and what continues to drive the work you do every day. Together, we have created something far greater than any one of us could have imagined or accomplished alone. And that’s the secret to our success. We bring out the best in each other. We lift each other up. We have made it possible to leave our “dent in the universe,” as Steve once described it, because of who we are and what we believe, because of what we value and how we see the world. How fortunate we are. How fortunate I am. As you know, I am not leaving Apple. But I am stepping away from a role that I have loved deeply. I will miss this work in ways I can only begin to imagine, even as I remain completely at peace with my decision. I will miss leading you and being with you for every step, even as I take enormous comfort in handing the helm to someone as brilliant and wonderful and capable as John. Few people understand what it takes to build products that change the world the way John does and I could not be more excited for his leadership.

articles.title: MapQuest's app surges to No. 1 in Navigation after refusing to rename Lake Ontario | TechCrunch
articles.summary: MapQuest is getting an unexpected boost from its decision to defy President Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario.
articles.body_text: MapQuest stood up to President Donald Trump, and now its app is reaping the rewards. The “OG of online mapping,” as the company calls itself, announced on Thursday that it would not change the name of Lake Ontario on its maps to Lake America, despite Trump’s executive order directing the U.S. Department of the Interior to update the lake’s name in the U.S. geographic naming service. As a result, MapQuest’s mobile app downloads soared, sending the iOS app to the No. 4 position on the U.S. App Store’s Top Charts for apps (not including games) as of Monday morning on the U.S. east coast. MapQuest also reached the No. 8 position overall in the U.S. App Store across both apps and games, and it became the No. 1 Navigation app in the United States. In Canada’s App Store, the app reached No. 2 overall as of Sunday evening. We’re not changing it. pic.twitter.com/NdeE9v2BNO The 30-year-old company remarked that it received “hundreds of thousands” of new downloads since its decision to keep the name Lake Ontario in place, and saw its app’s usage climb to 50 times above its normal levels. Third-party data from market intelligence provider Sensor Tower confirms the surge, noting that MapQuest saw 184,000 and 162,000 total global and U.S. app downloads respectively during the week beginning August 24, each representing an increase of more than 10x week-over-week. In the U.S., daily downloads were up 128% day-over-day from August 26 to August 30. “We took the same approach we did with the Gulf of Mexico: be part of the conversation, and give people an app that keeps the names they’re familiar with,” said Doug Berger, general manager of MapQuest, in a s t atement . “Hundreds of thousands of people signaled to us this weekend that we got it right by downloading our app.” MapQuest also released an online tool that lets you jokingly rename Lake Ontario to whatever you want it to be, then share the results on social media. The company had offered a similar tool last year, after Trump renamed the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America. Trump’s decision to rename the body of water bordering the U.S and Canada comes as trade talks broke down, leading the U.S. to impose new 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, with Canada poised to retaliate. On Saturday, Google Maps announced it was complying with Trump’s decision, explaining that it updates Google Maps to reflect the name changes in official government sources. In the U.S., that’s the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS). The updated map will only be shown to users in the U.S., while those in Canada will see Lake Ontario, and those outside of the two countries will see both names. Both Apple Maps and Google Maps changed the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America last year, after Trump issued a similar name-changing executive order.

Now, enterprises trying to harness that are learning to rebuild the basic elements of cybersecurity from scratch. This session is a candid technical conversation about what agent security actually requires at the infrastructure level, why application-level permission models are fundamentally flawed, and the architectural decisions that really matter when deploying agentic AI. articles.title: Sony’s new Back Button Attachment brings customizable paddles to the DualShock 4
articles.summary: Sony has announced a new DualShock 4 accessory that adds two customizable paddles. The Back Button Attachment, as it’s called, has an OLED screen that lets you easily assign any two commands to the rear of the controller.
articles.body_text: Sony has announced a new accessory that adds two customizable back paddle buttons to a DualShock 4 controller. It’s called the Back Button Attachment, and it features a crisp OLED display and a dedicated button that allows you to quickly remap controls on the fly without having to jump into a menu within the PS4. Sony says that it can store up to three unique control schemes at a time and that it works with all games, including PlayStation VR titles. This accessory will debut in the US on January 23rd for a reasonable $30. (I say “reasonable” because it’s clearly a play against Microsoft’s Xbox One Elite Series 2 controller, which also offers extra buttons — though, admittedly, a lot more buttons — for $179.99.) Aside from being much cheaper, Sony’s solution is clever because it works with any DualShock 4 controller. The accessory plugs into the port on the bottom of the controller, is powered by the controller, and allows for audio passthrough via its 3.5mm headphone jack. It’s peculiar for Sony to release an accessory like this so late in the PS4’s life cycle. Given that the PS5 is rumored to hit shelves by late 2020, Sony has either deemed that enough time to see if this experiment sticks or perhaps it’s a sign that the accessory will work with the DualShock 5.

articles.title: KD-källor: Släpper aldrig fram S – ”jag är inte orolig alls”
articles.summary: I Kristdemokraterna slår man ifrån sig anklagelserna om att partiet kan bli stödhjul till Magdalena Andersson.
articles.body_text: Ebba Buschs vänsterflörtande har skapat öppet bråk i Tidösamarbetet. I Kristdemokraterna slår man ifrån sig anklagelserna om att partiet kan bli stödhjul till Magdalena Andersson. – Den svängen kommer aldrig att hända, säger en källa. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Den senaste tiden har det stormat i Tidösamarbetet. I sitt sommartal i helgen gick Jimmie Åkesson till angrepp mot Ebba Busch och hennes flörtar med Socialdemokraterna. – Går det att lita på Ebba Busch? Jag vet inte det, sa SD-ledaren. Uttalandet fick Busch att styra om sin turnébuss till Sölvesborg för att tala ut med Åkesson. Från KD-håll beskrivs mötet som konstruktivt. – Hon såg Jimmie i ögonen och berättade hur det ligger till. Vi uppfattade det som att SD blev nöjda, säger en person med insyn. Trots det har Åkesson krävt nya svar från Busch. – Om man föredrar nyval framför att Magdalena Andersson blir statsminister, då gäller det att man säger det offentligt också, sa Jimmie Åkesson till SVT på måndagen. Sverigedemokraternas agerande förvånar kristdemokrater som Expressen talat med. De menar att övriga Tidöpartier har varit väl införstådda i strategin att locka väljare över blockgränsen. Det ska ha landat väl även hos Sverigedemokraterna, menar man.

articles.title: Kritiserar sin egen reform: ”Katastrof”
articles.summary: Centerpartiet var drivande i den kritiserade reformeringen av Arbetsförmedlingen – och insatsen Rusta och matcha. Nuvarande partiledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist är självkritisk.
articles.body_text: Centerpartiet var drivande i den kritiserade reformeringen av Arbetsförmedlingen – och insatsen Rusta och matcha. Nuvarande C-ledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist är självkritisk, och vill nu se en rad förändringar. – Det har varit katastrof både för de arbetssökande och för skattebetalarnas pengar, säger hon. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Det var i samband med Januariavtalet, där Stefan Löfven (S) och Miljöpartiet samarbetade med Centerpartiet och Liberalerna, som omstöpningen av Arbetsförmedlingen gjordes. Förändringen innebar att privata utförare fick ansvar för att rusta och matcha arbetslösa, och var till stor del en C-reform. – Arbetsförmedlingen ska göras om i grunden, för de arbetslösas skull, sa Martin Ådahl, C:s ekonomiska talesperson. Efteråt har kritiken för hur reformen föll ut varit omfattande. Det har handlat om att insatsen Rusta och matcha är dyr, har för dåliga resultat och att en del leverantörer av insatsen inte lever upp till krav som borde kunna ställas. Och nu har alltså även C landat i att det inte blev bra. – Uppföljningen och granskningen har varit alldeles för dålig. Vi kan vara självkritiska till att vi inte gjorde det tydligare, säger Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist. Det är tre olika delar i den självkritik C nu idkar.

articles.body_text: Tyskland anklagar Ryssland för en allvarlig drönarhändelse på flygplatsen i Leipzig i augusti. Sverige delar Tysklands slutsats och kommer att kalla upp Rysslands ambassadör för att uttrycka en skarp protest. Statsminister Ulf Kristersson (M) betonar att sabotaget hade kunnat få ”förödande konsekvenser för människoliv och europeisk luftfart” om det lyckats. – De vill skrämmas för att minska stödet för Ukraina, säger han. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Sent den 4 augusti hittades en drönare utrustad med sprängämnen i närheten av ukrainska fraktflygplan på flygplatsen i Leipzig. Ytterligare två drönare kopplas till händelsen – som den tyska regeringen nu officiellt anklagar Ryssland för. Den svenska regeringen håller en extrainsatt pressträff på tisdagskvällen och det nationella säkerhetsrådet ska ha möte på onsdagsmorgonen. Statsminister Ulf Kristersson (M) beskriver händelsen som ett ”mycket allvarligt försök till sabotage”. Han påpekar att flygplatsen används av både Nato och Ukraina. – Den här gången misslyckades sabotaget. Men det hade kunnat få helt förödande konsekvenser för människoliv och europeisk luftfart om det hade lyckats. – Det som kunde ha hänt kunde lika gärna ha hänt i varje annat land som stöttar Ukraina mot Rysslands krig. De vill skrämmas för att minska stödet för Ukraina. Ett pressat Ryssland, som är oförmöget att vinna på slagfältet men ovilligt att förhandla, tar allt större risker även i andra länder. Sverige står enat med Tyskland och med Ukraina. Kristersson berättar också att regeringen kommer att kalla upp Rysslands ambassadör i Sverige för att uttrycka en skarp protest. Justitieminister Gunnar Strömmer (M) säger att regeringen vet att Ryssland ägnar sig åt säkerhetshotande verksamhet, bland annat genom underrättelsetjänsterna, på olika plattformar. Han nämner ambassaden på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och den rysk-ortodoxa kyrkan i Västerås.

articles.title: Har Sverige köpt fyra moderna Vasaskepp?
articles.summary: Riskerar Sverige att lägga 47 miljarder på fyra toppmoderna Vasaskepp? Ja – om du frågar kritiker till köpet av de franska fregatterna. ÖB Michael Claesson slår tillbaka. – De tillför en helt ny luftvärnsförmåga med god verkan mot ballistiska robotar, säger han.
articles.body_text: Riskerar Sverige att lägga 47 miljarder på fyra toppmoderna Vasaskepp? Ja – om du frågar kritiker till köpet av de franska fregatterna. – De tillför en helt ny luftvärnsförmåga med god verkan mot ballistiska robotar, säger han. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Jämförelsen med Vasaskeppet är förstås tillspetsad. Sjödugliga kommer de 120 meter långa fregatterna förstås att vara. Toppmoderna och livsfarliga krigsmaskiner. Det bästa som står att finna i sitt slag – men också högprioriterade mål som riskerar att slås ut tidigt i händelse av krig, menar kritikerna. Den franska förlagan FS Amiral Ronarc’h har i veckan legat i centrala Stockholm. Med sitt pyramidformade radartorn når fartyget över Gamla stans takåsar. Bara fendrarna är stora som folkabussar. Ett respektingivande krigsfartyg värd drygt 10 miljarder kronor. Efter att Ulf Kristersson och Frankrikes president Emmanuel Macron på måndagen höll korta anföranden om fartygsaffären samt om det bilaterala försvarssamarbetet mellan Sverige och Frankrike mötte Expressen ÖB Michael Claesson ombord på Amiral Ronarc’hs akterdäck. Han försvarar den största militära utgiften för Sverige på många år. Han gör det med hänvisning till Rysslands attacker med ballistiska missiler mot Ukraina. – Fregatterna, säger ÖB, tillför en helt ny luftvärnskapacitet som Sverige hittills har saknat. Med särskilt god verkan mot just ballistiska robotar samt kapacitet att möta lufthot på en mängd olika höjdnivåer. Att Sverige behöver ett bättre skydd från hot från luften råder det stor enighet kring. Mot Ukraina kombinerar Ryssland sina robotattacker med svärmar av hundratals drönare och ibland också flygbomber. Under sommaren har civila mål så gott som dagligen träffats i den typen av massanfall. Om samma typ av anfall riktas åt vårt håll, klarar fregatterna då att både försvara sig själv och skydda mål på fastlandet? Klarar de att göra det dag efter dag? Svaren skiljer sig åt beroende på vem man frågar.

articles.title: Domen om ryska försöket: ”Ny nivå”
articles.summary: Tysklands regering pekar ut Ryssland för att ligga bakom drönarincidenten på Leipzig flygplats i början av augusti. Experten varnar för en ny nivå.
articles.body_text: Tysklands regering pekar ut Ryssland för att ligga bakom drönarincidenten på Leipzig flygplats i början av augusti. Natoländer har tidigare varnat för hotet mot ukrainska transporter – men detta är första konkreta incidenten. – Det är en nivåhöjning, säger försvarsexperten Hans Liwång. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Tysklands regering slår fast att de drönare som hittades på Leipzigs flygplats natten mot den 5 augusti var laddade med sprängämnen och tändanordning. De pekar ut Ryssland som ansvarig . Drönarna upptäcktes i närheten av ukrainska fraktflygplan. Natoländerna har sedan tidigare varit medvetna om hotet mot ukrainska vapentransporter från Europa, men detta är första gången en incident bekräftas. Det säger Hans Liwång, professor på institutionen för försvarssystem på Försvarshögskolan, och beskriver det som en ”allvarlig incident”. – Vi har inte hittills haft bekräftade sådana incidenter förrän det här. På så sätt är det en nivåhöjning, säger Liwång. Han vill inte sträcka sig till att kalla det för en upptrappning eftersom att det rör sig om en enskild incident snarare än en trend. – Men det är en ny nivå och en ny typ av hot, säger Liwång. Statsminister Ulf Kristersson gick snabbt ut och uttryckte sitt stöd för Tyskland . Han har kallat till ett nationellt säkerhetsmöte i morgon bitti. Liwång tror att han gör så för att tydligt signalera att de europeiska länderna står tillsammans. – Att detta inte är en fråga för ett enskilt land utan för alla länder som stöttar Ukraina, säger han och fortsätter: – Detta är något man befarat länge, men innebär denna incident att vi borde förändra någonting? Det är en annan fråga som är viktig för honom att signalera att han tar tag i.

articles.title: Ministerns sorg: ”Behöver förstå”
articles.summary: En man misshandlades till döds i Karlstad i helgen. Landsbygdsminister Peter Kullgren har varit bekant med mannen och kommenterar händelsen på Instagram.
articles.body_text: En man misshandlades till döds i Karlstad i helgen. Landsbygdsminister Peter Kullgren (KD) har varit bekant med mannen och kommenterar händelsen. – Det här spär ju på känslan av otrygghet, säger han. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Natten mot söndag blev en man i 50-årsåldern misshandlad till döds i centrala Karlstad. Enligt åklagaren uppstod ”tumult och bråk” och polisen eftersöker nu vittnen som kan ha sett eller hört något. Två män i 20-årsåldern är anhållna misstänkta för dråp. Händelsen har väckt starka reaktioner i sociala medier och nu kommenterar landsbygdsminister Peter Kullgren (KD), som har rötter i Karlstadstrakten, dödsmisshandeln. ” Jag kan knappt föreställa mig den sorg och vanmakt hans familj och vänner går igenom just nu ”, skriver han på Instagram. Kullgren säger till Expressen att han och den döde mannen kommer från samma kommun och var bekanta. – Det här är tragiskt framför allt för hans familj och närmaste. Mannen som dog och de två misstänkta ska inte ha känt varandra sedan tidigare. Polisen bedömer att det rör sig om en isolerad händelse – men Peter Kullgren håller inte riktigt med. ” För mig är inte detta en isolerad händelse utan en del av trend mot ökad otrygghet i Karlstad och Sverige. I det här fallet fick en man betala med sitt liv.”

Den tyska regeringen anklagar nu officiellt Ryssland för attentatsförsök. Statsminister Ulf Kristersson (M) uttrycker sitt stöd till Tyskland och kallar nationella säkerhetsrådet till möte i morgon. Ryssland hävdar att den tyska regeringen saknar bevis för anklagelsen och att man kommer att ”svara på alla antiryska beslut”. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Sent den 4 augusti hittades en drönare med sprängämnen och tändanordning på flygplatsen i Leipzig, i närheten av ukrainska fraktflygplan. Flera medier, däribland tyska Bild , har rapporterat att drönaren kan ha varit utrustad med Semtex. Samma natt misstänks en andra drönare, som inte återfunnits, ha kolliderat med ett DHL-fraktplan. Tio dagar senare hittades en tredje drönare väster om flygplatsområdet som också kopplas till händelsen. Tysk polis betraktar händelsen som ett försök till sprängattentat mot flyg- och logistikinfrastruktur. Den tyska regeringen anklagar nu officiellt Ryssland, skriver Reuters. Enligt inrikesministern Alexander Dobrindt följer händelsen ”mönstret av ryska hybridattacker”. – Vid attacken användes bland annat en drönarkonfiguration, olika komponenter, sprängämnen och cyberteknik som vi känner igen från andra ryska hybridoperationer och från Rysslands krig mot Ukraina, säger Dobrindt vid en pressträff enligt Politico. – Den tyska regeringen har därför dragit slutsatsen att Ryssland är ansvarigt för hybridattacken i Leipzig den 4 augusti. Tyskland kommer omedelbart att stänga det ryska konsulatet i Bonn. Hyreskontraktet för ett ryskt kulturcenter i Berlin har sagts upp, skriver TT.

articles.title: Norska kungafamiljen på sjukhus
articles.summary: Kung Haakon och drottning Mette-Marit anlände till Rikshospitalet på tisdagen. Nu har även prinsessan Märtha Louise kommit till sjukhuset.
articles.body_text: Mette-Marit uteblev från Haakons installation på grund av sjukdom. Bara timmar senare sågs Norges nye kung köra sin drottning till Rikshospitalet. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Flera medlemmar av den norska kungafamiljen samlades på Rikshospitalet på tisdagseftermiddagen. Kung Haakon och drottning Mette-Marit anlände vid 17-tiden, rapporterar Dagbladet. Haakon körde själv kungahusets Range Rover till sjukhuset, med Mette-Marit i baksätet. Klockan 17.40 anlände även prinsessan Märtha Louise. Drygt 40 minuter senare, klockan 18.22, lämnade Haakon sjukhuset. Dagbladet har frågat kungahuset om orsaken till kungaparets besök. Hovet hänvisar till beskedet som lämnades tidigare under tisdagen om Mette-Marits hälsa. Drottningen tvingades då utebli när Haakon avlade sin ed som kung inför stortinget på grund av komplikationer efter den lungtransplantation hon genomgick i juni. – Det är inte ovanligt med komplikationer efter en lungtransplantation. Drottningen har haft komplikationer vid några tillfällen sedan operationen, även i dag. Till följd av detta måste drottningen hållas under observation under dagen, sade lungläkaren Are Holm i ett uttalande. Detta är en nyhetsartikel.
